thread:
Maria T.: Heads-up — product asked for a console view to show how v1 token usage will map to v2 quota bands before we flip the default routing. want to surface predicted monthly spend change per tenant.
Ben R.: +1. can we do a conservative projection and an optimistic one? customers will ask for both.
Sanjay P.: also need to handle headerless clients that only send API keys. mapping there is fuzzy because they rely on legacy framing.
Elaine K.: For headerless, we have to infer client intent from historical route pattern. might need a '~probable mapping' badge.
Kevin L.: Suggestion: show three columns — historical tokens, projected v2 tokens (conservative), projected v2 tokens (estimated). quick math, no hard guarantees.
Maria T.: UX: add a toggle "apply smoothing (3mo)" — otherwise spikes will freak people out during the migration.
Ben R.: Agree on smoothing. Also surface which routes / models changed cost coefficient. small table: model v1->v2 coeff.
Sanjay P.: Implementation note: telemetry currently samples v1 requests at 1%. for migration projections we need raw counters or a short full-sample window.
Elaine K.: Can we run a 24h full-sample probe for selected tenants? ops-billing has a budget for 48h experiments.
Kevin L.: ops-billing approved a 12h full-sample for up to 200 tenants. we'll need a signal to opt tenants in and a fallback to prevent cost surprises.
Maria T.: OK — plan: opt-in probe, collect full sample, compute mapping locally, write projections to a read-only dashboard. no billing changes until cutover.
Ben R.: On routing side — we also need a flag to keep token affinity to v1 for a grace window per tenant. console should show "v2-pref: off/on" with dates.
Sanjay P.: Edge case: shared API keys used by multiple teams in a single tenant. When mapping, show per-key and aggregated views.
Elaine K.: UI note: show an estimated delta percent next to each key and a quick CTA: "Request review" that opens a ticket template.
Kevin L.: Telemetry detail: include sample rate and confidence interval on the projection. simple: CI = +/- sqrt(N)/N style estimate shown as percent.
Maria T.: Ops ask: we need an alert if projection increases cost >20% for any tenant. also a deploy-bot annotation when a tenant is scheduled for probe.
deploy-bot: probe-schedule created for tenant:redwood-staging window:2025-06-12T03:00Z duration:12h. @Kevin L. assigned.
Ben R.: Quick implementation sketch in pseudo: ```
// compute projected v2 tokens
proj = hist_tokens * model_coeff * smoothing_factor
ci = 1.96 * sqrt(sample_var / sample_n)
``` keep it simple.
Sanjay P.: Data privacy note: do not persist raw prompt text. only token counts and route/model tags.
Elaine K.: UX follow-up: add hover text explaining "model_coeff" with an example.
Maria T.: TL;DR: opt-in probe -> projections with CI -> per-key & per-tenant views -> smoothing toggle -> alerting for +20% -> retain v1 affinity toggle during grace. I'll write a short spec.
Kevin L.: I'll own the probe infra + alerting. assigning follow-up in the ticket. :thumbsup:
Maria T.: Thanks everyone. I'll drop the spec and the ticket link here when ready.
